separate_premise_inference_qualification.paragraph_action: Present an existing premise, its already-supported inference, and the qualified scope of practical applicability as distinct moves.
separate_premise_inference_qualification.sentence_action: Separate the premise from its inference; keep each condition attached to the applicability claim it qualifies.

separate_criterion_from_definition.paragraph_action: Contrast advance identification with a retrospective criterion, define the criterion, then justify its persistence requirement using the supplied counterexample.
separate_criterion_from_definition.sentence_action: Introduce the criterion separately from its definition; group the criterion emphasis with its existing rationale.

stage_existing_decisions.paragraph_action: Retain the scope and recommendation, introduce only the source-stated component count, then develop the existing decisions in order.
stage_existing_decisions.sentence_action: Separate the count announcement from the decisions; distinguish the first decision and coordinate the remaining decisions without adding steps.

bind_comparison_to_supported_inference.paragraph_action: Distinguish composition from propensity, present the characteristic component, attach the controlled inference to its comparison, and retain period and single-year evidence.
bind_comparison_to_supported_inference.sentence_action: Integrate an existing expected/actual comparison with its existing inference, without changing which quantities are expected, actual or differences.

retain_parallel_alternatives.paragraph_action: Retain parallel finding/alternative-explanation blocks; do not choose among the alternatives.
retain_parallel_alternatives.sentence_action: Keep alternatives paired with their corresponding finding and preserve their hypothetical status.
